notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello Splatians. This is yet another quality-of-life patch.
Over a year later, we are finally wrapping up some unfinished work – mainly the music. 

Several areas were still using placeholder tracks, and I had planned to remix some of DarksSilencer's pieces. Key spots like the S.P.A.R.K environment, quantum labs, and even the common boss theme were left incomplete. I always wanted the common boss theme to echo Lord Ashen's motif, so we have revisited and updated them.

By the way, give @DarksSilencer a YT sub - such neat indie music artists deserve more especially now!
And then Lord Ashen appeared again.
The event lined up with chocolatecake5000's run uncovering another softlock – perfect excuse to bundle bug fixes and music updates together.
Here's what's changed[olist]
Fixed Library Tunnel softlock reported by chocolatecake5000

Fixed potential softlock in Quantum Power Area

Replaced S.P.A.R.K., Quantum, and Storage Area themes with original music tracks

Replaced common boss theme with a new track by DarksSilencer

Updated Tomb and Arcade Boss battle themes with new originals
[/olist]Call to Action
Our first year was rough. We need your help to bring Desaturation more visibility. Share it with streamers or creators you know – most players who tried it enjoyed it.

Thanks for being part of Splatland and helping close the book on the Desaturation project.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9e
notes.content:
Hello Splatians. This is a small hotfix.

Here's what is changed:

In the Corrupted Castle, in the last room before entering the Ceremony Hall, if you are in a fight with the enemy and backtrack a little bit, and touch certain Holo-force-field wall, you can get saved in a very bad place, ending with, yes, the true reason for an emergency hotfix.... another softlock...

Again found by a streamer. Thank you, @Retr0_k

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9
notes.content:
Hello Splatians. Another quality of live patch.

Kudos to community member and small streamer Wankicha for finding very rare glitch that causes a barrel in Viscosity And Splattering to disappear. Well, the barrel never disappeared, it just got flinged into the stratosphere, or into the core void - as you decide to name it.

The game got some optimizations and some small quality of life improvements, too.

Here's what's new & changed:


 Viscosity & Splattering - barrel bug fixed.
 Lord Ashen will never remove colored strips from itself during a specific battle
 The Rainbow Crystal of Essence can now double-hit Lord Ashen.
 Removed some enemy souls in the second area of Soul Realm
 Fixed some bugs of the JRPG Battle System (again)
 Removed a slime with Black Crystal protection in the Soul realm.
 Changed how the paint looks at some surfaces.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/55ec815fd36e5938fce39dffff86c049b155c10c.png

For those who actually read patch notes:
We love you! If you love Desaturation, tell your friends about it!

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.8
notes.content:
This patch fixes multiple issues found by community members. Kudos to tajskiKoks for the most important fixes.


 In the Abandoned Mineshaft a barrel can get saved right on the moment when it explodes, bypassing softlock detection mechanism for this specific barrel. Now, the game will ignore any explosions that happen during load, the barrel will still explode, but the Splatian won't be harmed.
 While wearing the Atom Hat, you can end up softlocked in the Control Area. It's now possible to exit this area.


Some small issues related to input handling was fixed and some performance optimizations done in various places.

notes.title: It's that time! Cold, but...
notes.content:
Yes. It's the time for nominations.

Maybe you will never forget what that one slime did to you?
Maybe you forgot to jump in that one pool to realize you had to change how you look?
Maybe you did, but the scanner activated a trap and betrayed you?
Maybe you jumped on that moving platform, but its color was wrong, and you became pancake?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/5070d853c2d147d537941505abbcbe468cc90879.png

Maybe you managed to defeat that one boss, and wasted 20 minutes on thing that was in front of you all this time? Maybe you discovered one or two secrets there?
Maybe you seen a thing but couldn't figure the way to go and take it?
Maybe you discovered a sequence break that saved you a lot of time?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/55ec815fd36e5938fce39dffff86c049b155c10c.png

Maybe your resilience kicked in and you eventually explored all of Splatland?
Then you entered the final level and got puzzled out, or felt some retro nostalgia in there?

If you loved this experience, nominate our game for the most innovative gameplay?
And if you didn't and are still reading this, maybe go play a bit more.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.2
notes.content:
Hello Splatians. This is yet another quality of live patch.

Yes, we had a secret ending that we decided to cut before the release, because it wasn't fully polished. But it looks like there was at least one way to trigger this extra content and get some missing dialogue that stalled the entire True Ending sequence, and at least one of you discovered this bugged mess. 

it was a glitch related to the Atom Hat and the Golden Relics.

We've decided to just add this ending back & make it much easier to trigger. And we also fixed everything related to your Splatian's legacy. For you, secret seekers & Atom Hat lovers, the Ceremony Hall is important thing, but the Modular Factory is also important!

Here's what's new & changed:


 The Super Secret Ending is now easier to discover!
 Getting any of the 3 endings will now return you to the Temple prior the Final Battle
 Carefully checked the Alex Taylor Secret Quest (Library & quantum MFA)
 Made many fixes to "Amnesia" chain, especially in the Soul Realm
 Removed the first Red Soul in the Soul Realm Entrance
 Slightly nerfed the souls in Soul Realm Pool Table
 Removed some enemy souls in the Soul Realm Maze
 Fixed some bugs of the JRPG Battle System
 Added some strong hints during the Final Phase of the JRPG Final Battle
 Fixed many dialogue issues in the Chinese translation


For those who actually read patch notes:
Library - Atom Hat - Ceremony Hall - MFA Switch - Relics - SlimRemote

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello Splatians. This is another quality of live patch + a community Chinese localization for the game.

Here's what's new & changed:


 Fixed some glitches related to DemonWare behavior
 Made the SlimRemote Equip button in the briefcase screen actually work
 Fixed the display in Current & Information
 Added a cable in Current & Information to hint more about that puzzle
 Fixed minor bug in the Realm of the souls.
 Fixed a shader that was causing some issues on Steam Deck. 
 ADDED Simplified Chinese community localization to the game.

Note for AMD Radeon users. A MAJOR issue have been identified caused by third party overlays and the AMD Adrenaline overlay on some systems. 

If you have a high-end gaming system and Desaturation lags, please attempt to disable Discord's overlay and AMD Adrenaline's overlay. This may improve your performance. Call To Action

notes.title: DESATURATION warps into the handheld realm! Deck Verified ✅
notes.content:
Hello Splatians!

Lord Ashen broke his boundaries one more time.  While Peter was chilling and working, Lord Ashen channeled its soul into his quantumGG Steam Deck Mental Health Management Device made by one of the best and most influential teams in quantum labs at the time - the legendary VALVE team! 
Peter had to summon the Splatians there however, because Lord Ashen was threatening everyone with its annoying tricks! Ranina isn't happy, too, while Sparkle still researches the Rainbow Powder...

Enough quantum labs inc fiction! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/5fddfbcba64ffdff44f9a7a5746bcac78ec0ce72.png

Desaturation is now verified on Steam Deck!

The default settings are optimized for balanced experience. 
This is a 10+ hours game. 

If you want to trade more framerate for less time on battery, you can manually clock your GPU to 1.4GHz and above. For even more framerate but less quality, set In-game resolution to 848×480, quality to Marketing Mode and use Steam Deck's FSR. We also recommend keeping Tessellation to OFF on Steam Deck - while it makes the bricks and stones really appealing, this thing needs desktop class Nvidia dedicated GPU. We are also aware that some maps may not perform well, but in the upcoming weeks these places will also be fixed. (Yes, quantum station).

Patch 1.0.8 contains fixes mostly related to optimization.

 Underground trains no more cast super precise shadows.
 Most underground stations and some lights in tunnels were unnecessarily high quality.
 Marketing Mode fully disables the FSP Shaders now, may run faster on some cards
 Terrain shaders were slightly touched to better work on modern AMD GPUs.
 Fixed a potential soft-lock in Power Management (Atom Hat related)
 S.L.I.M.E. will no longer insta-kill you if you share color with them!

Are you ready to save your Steam Deck from Lord Ashen?

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello Splatians! Improving, improving, improving... This small update is here merely to fix newly discovered critical softlocks and do some small improvements

Here's what's changed:

1. If you get stubborn enough and move the crate in the Reception out of the yellow pool, it will reset. (Thanks Mr. Necrotic)
2. In the Forest Tunnel there were some places that you can go out of bounds. They were fixed (Thanks to AirKris and OneMore)
3. Fixed some typos in Bulgarian translation (Thanks myself and Pumzow)
4. Some minor fixes to Corrupted Castle
5. Small adjustments to Slime AI, in preparation for the upcoming Slime Update.

Reminder, we heard your feedback about difficulty!
We are working on providing a difficulty setting for easier slimes and less deaths due to this, but we will keep the original challenging slime mode for those of you who want some challenge and it will remain the default.

Call To Action
Feel free to share the game with streamers and content creators you know! We need your help to make Desaturation successful.

Community Translation Initiative
We will soon start an initiative for community translation. If you want the game translated to your language, feel free to tell us in our Discord.

That's it, thanks for being part of Splatland and helping shut-down the horrible Desaturation project.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello Splatians! A community Member discovered an interesting but very serious progression bug that may end you permanently stuck in the Divine Station Area. 

And while as usual, we blame Lord Ashen for these, it was very stupid oversight.

Here's what's changed:

1. Fixed the Copper Mine Station's Left Blockade area not blocking access to Divine Station. It's no longer  possible to enter Divine Station before it's intended time in the story.
2. If you are already stuck in the Divine Station area, The tunnel is now unlocked for you to backtrack and continue your run.
3. Added some cables and minor hints to places to hint you what to do.
4. Fixed the music in the Battle Of Balance (in Ceremony Hall).

5. Steam Deck: We removed the Share/Import buttons on Steam Deck - using these can crash your deck and/or get the game into weird corrupted state. 

We're very sorry if you entered Western Village Area and got stuck in there. 

And we heard your feedback about difficulty!
We are working on providing a difficulty setting for easier slimes and less deaths due to this, but we will keep the original challenging slime mode for those of you who  want some challenge and it will remain the default.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Splatians. We had quite interesting launch day.
Some of you discovered some interesting things, in the good sense, but some of you discovered bugs. Nothing serious, except some really annoying rocks and lava!

As usual, we blame Lord Ashen for them, and squish them the same way we do with Slimes.

Here is what's changed:

1. While nothing critical, we dug some hole in a certain level so you won't need to reload your save because of soft-lock. P.s. you can tap Delete to reset checkpoint if you are playing with keyboard.
2. The Basement Boss room was fixed.
3. Fixed some minor z-fighting graphical glitches - there are some remaining, too.
4. Fixed some very annoying section in the Mines, about rocks.
5. Fixed Discord's Rich presence
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/8450c982f9426c30b257c42b86a6b96a91d2879e.jpg
It now shows proper map percentage, and we added your death counter.
6. Fixed the Map Percentage in the status screen, too.

Minor stuff, but as a very small indie I want to be a good example of how I'm going to maintain the game.

With this in mind, what's next on the roadmap... is doing further polish and considering a mod support + level editor. And community localizations!
